gloss: Japanese sweets shop; traditional dessert café

definitions.gloss: Japanese sweets shop; traditional dessert café
definitions.explanation: A shop or café specializing in traditional Japanese sweets and desserts such as anmitsu, shiruko, and mochi. Often serves tea alongside the sweets.

examples.japanese: {甘味処|かんみどころ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦あんみつ→あんみつ：20653_anmitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate anmitsu at a Japanese sweets shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘味処|かんみどころ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a long-established sweets shop on this street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{甘味処|かんみどころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{寄|よ}って→立ち寄る：04638_tachiyoru⟧、⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白玉|しらたま}→白玉：13711_shiratama⟧⟦ぜんざい→ぜんざい：20244_zenzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: During my walk, I stopped by a Japanese sweets shop and ordered matcha and shiratama zenzai.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{甘味|かんみ}→甘味：13571_kanmi⟧ (sweets, sweetness) + {処|どころ} (place). Refers specifically to shops serving traditional Japanese desserts, as opposed to Western-style cafés or patisseries.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{甘味処|かんみどころ} are often associated with a nostalgic, old-fashioned atmosphere. Typical menu items include ⟦あんみつ→あんみつ：20653_anmitsu⟧, {汁粉|しるこ}, {善哉|ぜんざい}, わらびもち, and ⟦{白玉|しらたま}→白玉：13711_shiratama⟧だんご, often served with ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ or ⟦ほうじ{茶|ちゃ}→ほうじ茶：19098_houjicha⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘味処|かんみどころ} (long-established sweets shop)
- {甘味処|かんみどころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to go into a sweets shop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和菓子屋|わがしや}: Japanese confectionery shop — sells sweets to take home rather than eat in
- ⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧: café — a Western-style establishment
